units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10">Gen. R. s. 10</cite>, end; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 3">ib. s. 3</cite>, a. e. <he>לא בעמל ולא בי׳ וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>ביָגָע</he>) not with trouble and wearisome labor did the Lord create &c.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:1:20">Y. Snh. X, 28ᵃ</cite> top <he>לי׳</he>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:12:1">Koh. R. to XII, 12</cite> <he>לִיגִיעַת בשר</he> for painful study, v. <cite ref="E00069"><he>הִגָּיוֹן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Taanit 16a:16">Taan. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>ויש לו י׳ בשדה</he> has his labor invested in the field.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19:2">Lev. R. s. 19</cite>; Midr. Sam. ch. V <he>לא שכר י׳ וכ׳</he> does not the Lord reward the work of studying?; a. fr.—Pl. <he>יְגִיעוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 58a:4">Ber. 58ᵃ</cite>; Y. ib. IX, 13ᶜ top <he>כמה י׳ יגע וכ׳</he> how many labors did Adam have to go through &c.; (Tosef. ib. VII (VI), 2 <he>כמה יגע</he>).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28:2">Lev. R. s. 28</cite>, beg. <he>כמה י׳ הוא יגע</he>; a. fr.
